options.free_surface_rule: Clip all reference, voxel, P and T segments to Y >= input-inferred contact height + 2h; report this band separately from complete closed-section distances
options.voxel_agreement: all input voxel centers; material1 vs rest
options.ranking: report every profile; do not select or tune on hidden reference

reconstructed_to_reference.object_matching: all components pooled; no reference-center pairing

reconstructed_to_reference_closed.object_matching: all components pooled; no reference-center pairing

reconstructed_to_input_voxel_surface.object_matching: all components pooled; no reference-center pairing

reconstructed_to_input_voxel_surface_clo.object_matching: all components pooled; no reference-center pairing

input_voxel_to_reference.object_matching: all components pooled; no reference-center pairing

input_voxel_to_reference_closed.object_matching: all components pooled; no reference-center pairing

distance_direction_note: first=reference or input voxel; second=reconstructed model
distance_exclusions: main distance uses identical Y >= contact + 2h band for P/T/V/reference, clipping crossing segments; *_closed includes all physical XY boundaries and bottom corner changes; artificial Z end caps absent from interior XY cuts; not directly comparable to previous experiment free-surface scores

material_consistency.scope: every center of every cell in the supplied grid; no random sampling or truth bbox
material_consistency.continuous_volume_rule: midpoint quadrature of polygon areas on every voxel Z center; P curves discretized at stated step
material_consistency.center_tie_rule: inclusive X interval endpoints with 1e-9-cell tolerance; half-open Y crossings; tie counts reported

topology.section_scope: sampled XY planes; no proof over every continuous Z

saved_mesh.scope_note: checks shared-edge incidence, orientation and connectivity; does not prove absence of triangle self-intersections or vertex nonmanifoldness
saved_mesh.caps_note: bottom/contact and artificial Z caps included in closed-solid topology and volume only

model_metadata.algorithm: Lewiner marching cubes on binary (labels == 1), isovalue 0.5, one zero halo, no mesh smoothing/decimation
model_metadata.end_rule: zero halo creates an inferred cap at both observed domain ends; these are scan-window closures

build.algorithm: Lewiner marching cubes on binary (labels == 1), isovalue 0.5, one zero halo, no mesh smoothing/decimation
build.end_rule: zero halo creates an inferred cap at both observed domain ends; these are scan-window closures

worker.guard_scope: Python file-open audit plus isolated import path; not an OS sandbox
